name: Camera watch night shift
summary: Flip between camera feeds to track roaming threats, closing doors or lights to survive until morning while power drains.
core_loop: check camera → spot a threat approaching → shut the door or flash the light → power drops → survive until 6 AM
rules: each threat has its own route and tell
every action drains power
running out of power leaves you exposed
win: survive until the clock hits 6 AM
social_hooks: friends compare which night they reached
one Group member designs the roaming monsters
example_prompts: five nights at freddy's but at a pizza place run by my friend group
security camera survival game with ghosts
night shift at a haunted school where I watch cameras

name: Hide and hold breath
summary: A seeker patrols near the hiding spot and the player holds a button to hold breath, releasing only when it is safe.
core_loop: hide → hear footsteps → hold to stay silent → breath meter drains → release when it leaves
rules: holding drains breath
releasing too early makes noise
breath refills when you breathe
lose: breath runs out while it is near
social_hooks: friends compete on how many rounds they survive
example_prompts: hide in a closet while a monster walks past
outlast style hiding game
a game where I have to hold my breath so the ghost doesn't find me

name: Flashlight exploration

core_loop: sweep beam → find items in the dark → creatures freeze in light → battery drains → reach the exit
rules: creatures freeze or retreat in light
battery drains faster while lit
collect keys to exit
win: reach the exit with a key
lose: battery dies or a creature touches you

explore a dark mansion with only a beam of light
harry potter forbidden forest at night with a lantern
